scope: v2: recommendation consistency + tone + sample-vs-total + hedged-vs-asserted

findings.message: The 'About This Report' section opens in consistent first-person plural ('We audited', 'We fetch', 'We then review') but the final paragraph of that section switches to third-person ('Here we look at the web estate… MX runs deeper… Get the web estate right') before returning to first-person, mixing voices within the same section.
findings.context: "Here we look at the web estate: every page served over HTTP… MX runs deeper. A machine-ready estate covers every document type"

findings.message: The Structured Data Inventory section asserts 'a wider audit identifies the same gaps across the rest of the estate' as a direct finding, implying a full-site conclusion from a 7-page sample without any qualifying language that this is a prediction rather than an evidenced observation.
findings.context: "a wider audit identifies the same gaps across the rest of the estate"

findings.message: Priority 4 and the Div Soup section both state 'most pages across the audited set share the same template' to extend the bare-div finding beyond the single worst-case page, but only one page (https://typo3.org/association) is cited with data; asserting this pattern will 'persist beyond this single worst-case page' is overconfident given evidence from only one page.
findings.context: "the band is likely to persist beyond this single worst-case page, though the figures cited are specific to https://typo3.org/association"

findings.message: The Security Headers section summary states '3 of the five standard security headers are absent on every audited response' but the findings table in Priority 5 lists four absent headers (X-Frame-Options, CSP, HSTS, Permissions-Policy), creating an internal inconsistency that implies a different count for the full site than the per-page evidence supports.
findings.context: "3 of the five standard security headers are absent on every audited response: HSTS (Strict-Transport-Security), Content-Security-Policy (CSP), X-Frame-Options."
